about: Speech for the dealers (tools/speech.ts): which renderer draws the mouth, which voice reads, which rest film a dealer speaks over and the exact text of every line. The renderer is Scoutgaming's lip-sync worker (services/moving-gpu-worker in Jakeminator123/scoutgaming, release 8b1386c2…, its production image since 2026-11-11 according to docs/operations/images.json there), run in Docker inside WSL on this machine's graphics card and without network; nothing here touches Scoutgaming's production. bankId is the name the bank is bound to: 'paow-v2' because Scoutgaming already has an older dealer and film bank called PAOW, and calls a dealer from this repo Dealer V2.0 (as 'pamela-v2'). The lines are the ten a table needs (the SpeakLine ids of game/presentation.ts) with Scoutgaming's own texts, word for word (packages/presentation/contracts/recorded-line-texts.mjs and speech-lines.mjs, read 2026-11-13). names are the short Swedish names the studio's view Prov shows for the lines. The voice settings are the ones Scoutgaming's bakes use (runpod_bake.py, PROVEN_VOICE_SETTINGS); which voice is Paow's is Jakob's to choose, and 'jessica' stands until he has heard the three. Films made from this are takes of the step IDLE>IDLE with sound; they lie in assets/speech/<dealer>/ until they are entered in the bank.
